## Inventory (layered)

### Module list

- `src/molhub/__init__.py` — package root; re-exports `__version__` only. Docstring (lines 3-7) advertises `molhub.dataset` and `molhub.uploader`, but neither subpackage is imported here.
- `src/molhub/_version.py` — single hardcoded `__version__ = "0.1.0"` string (duplicated in `pyproject.toml:7`).
- `src/molhub/dataset/__init__.py` — dataset subpackage facade; re-exports protocols + all four concrete sources.
- `src/molhub/dataset/protocol.py` — declares the dataset contract (`MapDataset`, `IterableDataset`, `Sample`, `TargetSchema`) **and** ships two concrete implementations (`InMemoryDataset`, `SubsetDataset`, lines 128-173).
- `src/molhub/dataset/csv_dataset.py` — CSV source: cache-path resolution, HTTP download, stdlib-`csv` parsing, row→`Frame` mapping.
- `src/molhub/dataset/qm9.py` — QM9 source: hardcoded Figshare URLs, tarball download, bz2 archive indexing, deterministic subsampling, xyz parsing, target filtering, lazy frame cache.

- `src/molhub/uploader/figshare.py` — Figshare REST client: article creation, single/multi-part file upload, combined create+upload.
- `src/molhub/uploader/huggingface.py` — thin wrapper over `huggingface_hub` free functions (`upload_file`, `upload_folder`, `create_repo`) plus a combined `upload_dataset`.

### Style summary

- **Naming** — modules `snake_case`; classes `PascalCase`. Two competing suffixes for the same role: `*Source` (`QM9Source`, `RevMD17Source`, `ThreeBPASource`) vs `*Dataset` (`CSVDataset`, `InMemoryDataset`, `SubsetDataset`). Module-private helpers/constants are `_`-prefixed; class-level constants are public-cased (`BASE_URL`, `TARGET_SCHEMA`, `ALL_TARGETS`, `SOURCE_VERSION`). `source_id` uses a colon-delimited convention: `"qm9:v2:total=…"` (qm9.py:270-276), `"csv:{name}:n={n}"` (csv_dataset.py:179), `"3bpa:{tag}:size=…:n=…"` (threebpa.py:120), `"revmd17:{mol}:size=…:n=…"` (revmd17.py:119), `"memory:{name}:{n}"` (protocol.py:142), `"{parent}:subset={hash12}"` (protocol.py:162-163).
- **Construction** — direct `__init__` everywhere; no `make_*`/`build_*` factories. Two classmethods named `download` (csv_dataset.py:156, qm9.py:262) are *not* alternate constructors — both return `Path`, i.e. static side-effecting utilities hung on the class. Constructors do heavy work: `CSVDataset.__init__` resolves cache path, downloads, and parses (122-136); `ThreeBPASource.__init__` parses the whole file (115); `RevMD17Source.__init__` performs `np.load` (97-113); `QM9Source.__init__` triggers download (237-238). Duplicate implementation: `CSVDataset._resolve_cache_path` (140-148) and `_resolve_cache_path_static` (164-173) share the same body.
- **Error handling** — `ValueError` for unknown enum-like keys (qm9.py:227, revmd17.py:79, figshare.py:46), `FileNotFoundError` with remediation text (csv_dataset.py:128,134; qm9.py:243,248; revmd17.py:89,95; threebpa.py:110; figshare.py:117), `KeyError` for missing npz keys (revmd17.py:100). HTTP status is checked **only** in the uploader path via `resp.raise_for_status()` (figshare.py:95,131,137,144,152,159); the dataset download path performs **no** status check. Bare `assert` for internal invariants (csv_dataset.py:153; qm9.py:173,280,285) — vanishes under `python -O`. One `print()` for progress (qm9.py:135) instead of logging.
- **Lazy loading** — one explicit lazy-frame pattern: `QM9Source._frames: list[Frame] | None` + `_ensure_frames_loaded()` guard (qm9.py:234,253-260,279,284). All other sources are eager. Lazy third-party imports keep optional deps optional: `import requests` inside `FigshareUploader.__init__` (figshare.py:41, stored as `self._requests` but never used afterwards), and function-local `from huggingface_hub import …` (huggingface.py:70,106,138) — the latter is what `tests/test_uploader.py:23` exploits via `sys.modules` injection.
- **Docstrings** — Google style (`Args:`/`Returns:`/`Raises:`) per `mol_project.doc.style`, mixed with Sphinx roles (`:class:`, `:meth:`, `:attr:`) and reST `Usage::` blocks in every module header. Dataset modules carry a literature `Reference:` block (qm9.py:3-5, revmd17.py:3-6, threebpa.py:4-7).
- **Type annotations** — complete on all signatures; `from __future__ import annotations` in every implementation module. Union syntax `str | Path`, `frozenset[str]` throughout. `@dataclass(frozen=True)` for `TargetSchema` (protocol.py:41-55). Three `# type: ignore` escapes: csv_dataset.py:148, revmd17.py:26, plus one in tests. **No type checker is configured** (`pyproject.toml` has ruff only).
- **Downloads / IO** — two independent, near-identical stdlib download helpers: `csv_dataset.py:89-93` and `qm9.py:64-67`, both `urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})` then `dest.write_bytes(r.read())`. Both read the entire body into memory, write directly to the final path, and check **neither HTTP status nor content digest** — no temp file, no atomic rename. Upstream URLs are hardcoded Python constants (qm9.py:60-61, revmd17.py:65) — no manifest or index. Cache root is `$MOLHUB_CACHE_DIR` → `~/.cache/molhub` (csv_dataset.py:143-146,168-171); `QM9Source` uses a caller-supplied `root` with no cache convention at all. `revmd17.py:26` sets `ssl._create_default_https_context = ssl._create_unverified_context` at import time — a process-global TLS-verification downgrade executed as a side effect of `import molhub.dataset`. Progress reporting uses `tqdm` bound to `sys.stdout` inside library code (qm9.py:152,171).

### Layer roles

Target layers: **L1 transport** (locator → fetch → verify digest), **L2 resolution** (coordinate → locator list, index/manifest, versioning), **L3 semantic** (bytes + format → `Frame` / `TargetSchema`).

- `src/molhub/__init__.py` — **none** (package metadata only).
- `src/molhub/_version.py` — **none** (package metadata only).
- `src/molhub/dataset/__init__.py` — **L3 facade**; currently also the only public entry point for sources that internally reach L1/L2.
- `src/molhub/dataset/protocol.py` — **L3**, cleanly. No network, no locators. Cohesion note (not a layer straddle): the module both declares the contract (41-120) and ships two concrete implementations (128-173).
- `src/molhub/dataset/threebpa.py` — **L3**, cleanly. `_parse_extxyz` (35-87) is bytes→`Frame` only; constructor takes a local path.
- `src/molhub/dataset/csv_dataset.py` — **straddles L1 + L2 + L3.** L2: `_filename_from_url` (82-86), `_resolve_cache_path` (140-148), `_resolve_cache_path_static` (164-173). L1: `_download` (89-93). L3: `_infer_value` (36-50), `_parse_csv` (53-74), `__getitem__` (184-188). Fused in the constructor: `:124` resolve → `:126` fetch → `:136` parse.
- `src/molhub/dataset/qm9.py` — **straddles L1 + L2 + L3**, the widest straddle in the repo. L2: `_DEFAULT_URL`/`_EXCLUDE_URL` (60-61), `SOURCE_VERSION` (205) as an ad-hoc versioning token. L1: `_download` (64-67), `_ensure_downloaded` (126-138) — fetch + existence-based caching, no status/digest verification. L3: `_parse_xyz` (79-115), `_load_exclusion_list` (70-76), `_filter_targets` (118-123). Fusion point: `_load_raw` (141-176) calls `_ensure_downloaded` (L1) at :143, indexes the tarball, applies seeded subsampling (165-167), and parses (174) — one function spanning all three layers.
- `src/molhub/dataset/revmd17.py` — **straddles L1 + L2 + L3**, degenerate. L2: `_MOLECULES` (29-40), `BASE_URL` (65). L1: **no fetch is implemented** — `revmd17.py:88-93` raises `FileNotFoundError` even when `download=True`, instructing the user to download manually. The L1 slot is occupied by an import-time global TLS downgrade at `:26` that nothing in this module uses. L3: `np.load` + array unpacking (97-114), `__getitem__` (124-141).
- `src/molhub/uploader/figshare.py` — **outside the L1/L2/L3 read path**; write-side transport (L1 counterpart in the upload direction).
- `src/molhub/uploader/huggingface.py` — **outside the L1/L2/L3 read path**; write-side transport.

Cross-cutting, stated factually:

- **No module implements digest verification.** `hashlib` appears exactly once, at `protocol.py:162`, hashing an index list for a `source_id` — not verifying bytes.
- **No `Registry` type, no manifest/index reader, no coordinate parser** exists today; L2 is represented only by per-module hardcoded constants and lookup dicts.
- The on-disk cache today is `$MOLHUB_CACHE_DIR`/`~/.cache/molhub` with filename-derived paths — **not** the content-addressed `$MOLHUB_HOME/blobs/sha256/<ab>/<full>` + `refs/` layout named as a frozen contract in `CLAUDE.md`. That contract describes the **target** state; nothing in the tree conforms to it yet.
- Test coverage maps onto layers unevenly: the two pure-L3 modules (`protocol.py`, `threebpa.py`) plus the L3 half of `csv_dataset.py` have tests; the two modules with the most L1/L2 entanglement (`qm9.py`, `revmd17.py`) have **none**.
